description: Removal of an existing InLink Unit and replacement new street hub.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.
Reason: To prevent the accumulation of unimplemented planning permissions and to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and to meet the requirements of Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and to meet the requirements of The Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.
Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the reports, specifications and drawings detailed [STREET HUB ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR MANAGEMENT PLAN VERSION 3, WAN13/LIB/XX/XX/DR/LD/2100/D5 REVISION P1, WAN13/LIB/XX/XX/DR/LD/2300/D5 REVISION P1, WAN13/LIB/XX/XX/DR/LD/2301/D5 REVISION P1, WAN13/LIB/XX/XX/DR/LD/1000/D5 REVISION P1, BT STREET HUB UNIT DIMENSIONS RECEIVED: 03 JAN 2026, ]. 
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme. 
Condition : 3 - The footway and carriageway on Putney High Street shall not be blocked during the installation of the Street Hub hereby approved. Temporary obstructions during the installation shall be kept to a minimum and should not encroach on the clear space needed to provide safe passage for pedestrians or obstruct the flow of traffic on the A219 Putney High Street. All vehicles shall only park/ stop at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions.

REASON: In order to prevent highway obstructions in accordance with London Plan Policy T4 and Local Plan Policies LP9 and LP50.
Condition : 4 - Prior to first operational use of the Street Hub hereby approved, the two existing phone boxes outside 64 Putney High Street as indicated on the submitted location plan (ref: WAF-15.1000 ISSUE: P1) shall be removed. 
Reason: In order to prevent the over-proliferation of street clutter, which causes harm to visual amenity and ease of pedestrian movements, in accordance with London Plan Policy D8 and Local Plan Policy PL9. 
Condition : 5 - The Street Hub hereby approved shall be operated in accordance with the submitted: Street Hub Anti-Social Behaviour Management Plan Version 3.
Reason: To prevent the Street Hub becoming a magnet for anti-social behaviour. 
Condition : 6 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.
